_doc: Quest templates fire from the simulation when a resident's needs, traits, problem and town state fit (giver block) and the town fits (town block). The sim only creates a quest HOOK: giver, filled roles, solution paths and war effects. The quest system turns a hook into objectives. needs: '<30' or '>70'. roles pick other residents: job_tags:a|b, same_job, neighbour, household, authority, outsider (someone in another town of the region). chance = per eligible giver per day. war = which power each solution path tips toward (applied when the quest system reports the outcome). town: resonance [lo,hi], threat_min, kinds, held_by, changed_hands_within (days since a power took the town).

debt.name: A debt come due
debt.pitch: I owe {creditor} more than I'll earn this season. If you could talk them round, or find the coin somewhere...

feud.name: Bad blood
feud.pitch: {rival} has been moving my fence posts a foot a night. Next time I'm taking a shovel to them. Unless you'd sort it first.

missing_person.name: Never came home
missing_person.pitch: {missing} went up the road to {missing_town} and hasn't sent word. That's not like them.

sabotage.name: Undercut
sabotage.pitch: {rival} is selling below cost. Someone's paying them to ruin me, and I'd like to know who.

claim_dispute.name: Two names on one deed
claim_dispute.pitch: The Assay Office says {rival} filed on my land first. I've worked that ground six years. Ask {registrar} how that happened.

cursed_object.name: It whispers
cursed_object.pitch: My grandmother's brooch came out of the ice with her. Since then the dog won't sleep in the house.

strike.name: Down tools
strike.pitch: {boss} cut our pay again. We're thinking of walking out. Would you stand with us, or at least carry a letter?

failing_harvest.name: Grey fields
failing_harvest.pitch: The seed won't take since the pumps came. Either the shrine needs waking, or I need one of those Combine threshers. Can't afford either.

protection.name: Something on the road
protection.pitch: Two carts didn't make it in from {road_town} this week. Whatever's out there, someone should deal with it before it comes here.

sick_relative.name: Fever in the house
sick_relative.pitch: {healer} says it's lung-rot and wants more than I have. A priest might pray it off, or there's a Combine tonic, if you trust it.

lost_item.name: Dropped on the road
lost_item.pitch: I lost my mother's ring somewhere between here and {road_town}. I'd pay to have it back.

faith_crisis.name: Two masters
faith_crisis.pitch: {boss} says anyone caught at the shrine loses their place. I don't know whether to pray or keep my job.

smuggling.name: No questions
smuggling.pitch: There's a crate needs to reach {road_town} without the Assay Office seeing it. Good pay, and nobody opens it.

town_fallen.name: New masters
town_fallen.pitch: Since {holder} took the town, they've been going door to door. I need my papers out of the {holder_office} before they read them.
